text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
choice_data_list: No, you don't need to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry. That was an apology to my 
family just now.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Even though I was blessed with such a 
wonderful body, I failed to make the most 
of it...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
choice_data_list: That was a great run, so very you.

That was a great run, very true to 
yourself.

Let's train hard so we can deliver real 
results next time!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
choice_data_list: That was a great run, so very you.

That was a great run, very true to 
yourself.

Let's train hard so we can deliver real 
results next time!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that is very kind of you. 
However, there is no need to worry about 
me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Despite its small stature, this body 
harbors peerless ability. The fact that I 
failed to make full use of it is 
undeniable.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If we can draw out your strength, victory 
is assured... Or so I believe.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm relieved to know that you share 
the same opinion, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let us continue to dedicate ourselves. For 
this body deserves nothing less than 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For that, we may need to review the 
plan as well.
choice_data_list: I'll come up with a plan to win.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, keep your eyes fixed straight ahead. 
Turn defeat into nourishment.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I won't make the same mistake twice, 
either. If more training is what it takes, 
then let us forge ourselves thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This body my family gave me might be 
delicate, but it's by no means puny. I run 
to prove that.
